metadata.title: Punjab development schemes — demonstration subset
metadata.provenance: Hand-seeded from published Punjab Annual Development Programme material and departmental announcements. NOT a scrape: pndpunjab.gov.pk, finance.punjab.gov.pk and pitb.gov.pk all sit behind a WAF that refuses non-browser clients, so no automated import was possible from outside Pakistan.
metadata.readThisBeforeDemoing: These are illustrative records with realistic structure, not a verified register. The production answer is a one-day import from the department's own ADP database, which they hold and we do not. Say that rather than implying this is live data — the customer owns the real thing and would rather it came from their system than from anyone's scrape.
metadata.shortfallRule: Every scheme carries `delivered` and `target`. The UI always renders both. A communications tool that only surfaces completions is one freedom-of-information request from embarrassing its owner, and the gap is the number the minister will be asked about anyway.
